decisions.reason: Requiring an original fresh-perspective creative does not alter the viral hook, three-second attention window, or use of validated structural hook principles.
The originality direction does not change the lead-generation objective or target CPL.
The testimonial-format effect is already completely represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY establishing couple discussion or multiple-patient testimonials.
The creative-direction change does not alter the number, duration, or aspect ratios of the required video outputs.
The suggested testimonial scenarios do not revoke or modify the existing realistic, native-looking UGC visual standard.
The source changes creative originality and presentation examples but does not change the target audience age range.
The source does not change the freelancer's responsibility to supply the footage, voiceover, and script.
The source concerns video creative direction and has no effect on the deferred landing-page and tracking audit.
The originality and testimonial-format direction does not resolve or modify the audio-level requirement or its existing ambiguity.
The source does not change the requirement for suitable retention-focused cuts.
Although the suggested concepts may contain dialogue, the source does not change the existing proper lip-sync standard.
The suggested couples or patients do not change the separately established requirement to use only Indian actors, preferably male.
